name: network-scan-detector
description: Passively watches inbound packets and reports sources that probe many distinct ports in a short window (SYN, FIN, NULL, Xmas, connect and UDP scans).
author: TrueSignal
documentation: Captures inbound frames with an AF_PACKET socket (headers only, never payloads). Runs as UID 0 with every capability dropped except NET_RAW, host network, read-only filesystem, no-new-privileges. Only TCP segments without ACK/RST and UDP datagrams count, so established traffic never looks like a scan. Tool guesses (nmap, masscan, zmap) come from public SYN fingerprints and are left empty when not confident. CPU cost grows with inbound packet rate: every inbound frame is read in user space.

config.name: TS_THRESHOLD
config.description: Distinct destination ports from one source that count as a scan

config.name: TS_IGNORED_PORTS
config.description: Destination ports never counted (e.g. busy services)

config.name: TS_IGNORE_LOOPBACK
config.description: Ignore traffic on the loopback interface

config.name: TS_MAX_SOURCES
config.description: Sources tracked at once (least recently seen are evicted)

triggers.name: network_scan_detected
triggers.description: A source probed at least TS_THRESHOLD distinct ports within TS_WINDOW_SEC
